sentences.text:
PER COURT :
 Heard both the sides.

2. The learned APP on written instructions from the Food Safety Officer Mr. U.R. Suryawanshi submits that the petitioner is ready to furnish bond proviso to Section 38 (1) (c) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, the shop can be desealed.

3. The learned advocate for the petitioner on instructions submits that the petitioner is ready to execute the bond in terms of the proviso of Section 38 (1) (c) and also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that he will not store/keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc., in his shop and will not use his shop for selling those articles in future.
